title: Zuriel Original-Language Word Study Collection — Batch 1
description: Context-sensitive Hebrew, Greek and Aramaic word-study cards. These are study aids, not a substitute for verse-level parsing or critical lexicons.
editorialPolicy: Transliterations and glosses are concise aids; check the actual form and syntax in each passage.
No Strong's identifiers, morphology, pronunciation audio or exhaustive semantic claims are supplied unless separately verified.
Do not derive theology from etymology alone; context governs meaning.
Respect Jewish reading conventions for the divine name.
